EXCELLENT PIZZA FOR VEGETARIANS.
Jan 2019
We visited. Halong. Bay in. January 2019 18 to 20.
We stayed in. SONG. LOC HOTEL .
14pizza Place came in very handy because it was close to the hotel .
Though language was a problem but through trial and error and with the help of owners I PAD it was possible to translate and get what we wanted .
Being vegetarians I had to make sure he understood I donot want even fish sauce or eggs.
To my surprise he did a supurb and appetizing pizza with less cheese with more of vegetables over beer. To be sure we ordered only one pizza to be sure it was done to our perfection.
We were hungry and had to order another one same crust .
He was the only one baking so we had to be very patient with the food. 
We even helped him to take some orders over the phone as person on the other side didnot speak Vietnamese.
I certainly will recommend this place for dinner .
Please make sure u go with lots of patience..
Thx 14 PIZZA. Halong .

Amazing Service
Jun 2018
After a stressful experience in Ha Long City, we were so relieved to be able to order food and have it delivered to our hotel. We messaged 14 Pizza on Facebook asking if delivery was possible, to which they swiftly replied (in English) and asked what we would like to order. The person we spoke to on Facebook was lovely, helpful and informative. Our food was delivered within 30 minutes by a friendly driver. The food was reasonable for the price, with three vegetarian pizzas available. The service and food was definitely comforting after a stressful experience in Ha Long.
Written June 9, 2018
